notes.title: Releasing my 2nd game on Steam!
notes.notes:
TERFs aren't the only fascists transgender people have to deal with. My upcoming game is about fighting transmedicalists that gatekeep health care for trans people of all ages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2314960/Trans_Agent_X/?beta=1

Evil gatekeepers. Transgendered protagonist. Overdue reckoning. 
This is a casual sci-fi action-adventure bullet-hell dodger about transgender people re-visiting a post-apocalyptic earth and searching for a lost artefact. A wholesome trauma-healing adventure.

[previewyoutube=akDdn8ha0bo;full][/previewyoutube]

Creating games that represent and shows the challenges trans and queer people face is important.
I'm wanting to create and make room for more diversity in the future as well, so stay tuned < 3

notes.title: Game is now released!
notes.notes: Thank you all for sharing your patience with me about the release of my very first steam game, hope you enjoy it : )

notes.title: Official release announcement!
notes.notes:
[b]Game will be released as soon as possible in the month of December.[/b]

I made the mistake of not taking into account that steam wants to review the game one last time before publishing.
The game is in the review queue, it will take, according to steam, 2-3 days.

Thank you for your patience < 3
